mapper.insert: insert into kitchen_product_routings (store_id, product_id, kitchen_station_id, created_at, updated_at) values (#{storeId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{productId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{kitchenStationId,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) on duplicate key update kitchen_station_id = values(kitchen_station_id), updated_at = values(updated_at), deleted_at = null
mapper.select: select , p.name as product_name, s.name as station_name from kitchen_product_routings r left join products p on p.id = r.product_id left join kitchen_stations s on s.id = r.kitchen_station_id where r.store_id = #{storeId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and r.product_id = #{productId,jdbcType=INTEGER} and r.deleted_at is null
